notes: The Okanogan County PUD Commissioner District 1 seat is elected by the whole PUD, which is Okanogan County except about 325 registered voters in the northeast who are in Ferry County PUD No. 1 (Commissioner #3 race); no public GIS layer separates the two, so both PUD seats are scoped PUDDST and hidden (partial_county).
The Methow Valley EMS levy is scoped EMSDST 'MV' (WA DOR EMS2025, layer 6, DISTATTRIB); the Fire District 1 levy FIRDST '1' (layer 7) and the Three Rivers hospital bonds HOSPDST '1J' (layer 11).
Unresolvable district scopes (no queryable official boundary): PUDDST. Contests/measures scoped to them are hidden rather than shown to the wrong voters.
